front.title: SHA-384 and SHA-512 Binary Merkle Tree Verifiable Data Structures for COSE Receipts

abstract.t: RFC 9942 defines COSE Receipts and registers one verifiable data structure, RFC9162_SHA256, the binary Merkle tree of RFC 9162 instantiated with SHA-256. This document registers two more: RFC9162_SHA384 and RFC9162_SHA512, the same tree instantiated with SHA-384 and SHA-512, each with its inclusion and consistency proof types. The tree construction, proof formats, and verification algorithms are unchanged apart from the hash function and the resulting digest size.
